data.gender_notes: Anek is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anek is a Sanskrit name meaning 'unique', 'individual'. It is derived from the root word 'aneka' which means 'many' or 'numerous'. This name signifies the uniqueness and individuality of every person, emphasizing the importance of self-expression and personal growth. The name Anek carries the meaning “Unique, Individual” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anek usually hope their child will grow to embody unique, individual and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embrace your individuality and unique path in life.
data.etymology: Anek belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Unique, Individual.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anek total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
